rationale: The paper 'The California Legacy Survey. VI. The Fate of Activity Cycles in Sun-like Stars' provides evidence on changes in stellar activity cycles and suggests measurable changes to the stellar dynamo, contributing substantive new evidence to the question of why the solar activity cycle is well characterized yet poorly understood.
